name: signup-block
title: Sign-up block
description: A three-step sign-up card (details with a password meter, an emailed code with a resend countdown, a drawn tick) and a compact sign-in card, made of the Rabtx components. CSS-only motion.

.rx-signup-progress-dot.transition: background-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), border-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), color 200ms var(--motion-ease), box-shadow 200ms var(--motion-ease)

.rx-signup[data-moved] .rx-signup-panel[.transition: opacity 220ms var(--motion-ease) 40ms, translate var(--spring-panel-duration) var(--spring-panel), filter 220ms var(--motion-ease) 40ms
